characters.name: 弗兰奇
characters.description: 弗兰奇是《海贼王》中的角色，草帽海贼团的船匠，身体经过机械改造，原是水之都弗兰奇一家的首领，曾是造船师汤姆的徒弟，在水之都篇登场，设计并建造万里阳光号，常喊出SUPER作为口头禅，擅长维修和改装船只，重视同伴并富有感情，梦想让自己打造的船抵达伟大航路终点。他起初与路飞一行发生冲突，后来因罗宾和司法岛事件成为伙伴。看似张扬的外表下，他对朋友与船只有很强的责任心。

source.description:
__Height:__ 225 cm (7'4½")
__Affiliation:__ Straw Hat Pirates (previously; Franky Family, Tom's Workers)
__Position:__ Shipwright
__Devil Fruit:__ None
__Bounty:__  ~!394,000,000 (previously; 44,000,000 and 94,000,000)!~

Franky is a cyborg who is the shipwright of the Straw Hat Pirates. He first appeared in the Water 7 arc. Franky is one of "Tom's Workers".

Franky's dream is to build a ship that would travel to the end of the Grand Line. This is the ship that the Straw Hats are currently riding, but his dream is not yet achieved until they make it to the end.

Franky usually acts tough and is quickly angered, but he is also very emotional when it comes to sad tales and often bursts into large tears, or on some occasions, plays a song. His most distinguishable personality trait is his flamboyant attitude. He frequently shouts the word 'SUPER' when he's in a positive mood, or adds it into his speech. He also has a signature pose which he uses very often.

Franky is quick to defend other people (eg. Franky Family, [Nico Robin](https://anilist.co/character/61/Nico-Robin)) and take action if his friends are harmed. He is also quick in making friends, allies, and comrades with even the most unlikely of individuals. Because of this, he is seen as a 'big brother' figure. [Monkey D. Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Monkey-D-Luffy) bears similar qualities (with the exception of engaging in unnecessary fights) and because of this, despite the disputes the two had in the past, both grew to respect each other during the events of the Enies Lobby Arc.

characters.name: 布鲁克
characters.description: 布鲁克是《海贼王》中的角色，草帽海贼团的音乐家，以骷髅身体活动，生前曾加入伦巴海贼团，吃下黄泉果实后复活，擅长演奏小提琴，使用手杖剑战斗，喜欢讲与骨头有关的笑话，拥有魂之王称号，珍视与拉布的约定，希望再次见到等待自己的鲸鱼拉布。他因果实能力在死后重返人世，却长期独自在海上漂流。加入草帽一伙后，他把音乐带给伙伴，也始终没有忘记旧友。
traits: 生前曾加入伦巴海贼团
喜欢讲与骨头有关的笑话

source.description:
__Height:__ 266 cm (8'8½")
__Affiliation:__ Straw Hat Pirates (previously; Rumbar Pirates)
__Position:__ Musician, Swordsman
__Devil Fruit:__ Yomi Yomi no Mi (Revive Revive Fruit)
__Devil Fruit Type:__ Paramecia
__Bounty:__  ~!383,000,000 (previously; 33,000,000 and 83,000,000)!~

Brook known as the "Gentleman Skeleton", is a pirate inhabiting the Florian Triangle region of the Grand Line. Although he claims to be a gentleman, and talks in the dialect of one, Brook's etiquette has severely degenerated over the course of his isolation. He has awful table manners: he shouts for food while waiting to be served, asks to swap plates with people who have larger servings than he does and eating so messily his entire face is stained. He is also extremely flatulent after meals, but says "excuse me" so as to be "gentlemanly." He also loves to tell odd, bone-themed jokes, as well as melodramatic tales, and is very perverted, asking to see [Nami](https://anilist.co/character/723/Nami) and [Robin](https://anilist.co/character/61/Nico-Robin)'s underwear upon meeting them.

He's a skilled musician (something [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Monkey-D-Luffy) has always wanted in his crew since the beginning), fond of playing the violin. Due to his light weight he can not only jump to incredible heights but can run on water by moving his legs furiously. He uses a shikomizue as his main weapon; with it, he is able to make swift iaidō attacks that the enemy cannot notice.

characters.name: 甚平
characters.description: 甚平是《海贼王》中的角色，草帽海贼团的舵手，鲸鲨鱼人，外号海侠甚平，曾担任太阳海贼团船长，曾是王下七武海，擅长鱼人空手道，在海中拥有很强的行动能力，行事沉稳重视道义，多次帮助路飞脱离险境，加入草帽一伙共同航海。他在鱼人与人类之间的矛盾中坚持自己的信念，既有强大的战斗能力，也善于冷静判断局势。与路飞建立信任后，他选择正式成为同伴。

__Affiliation:__ ~!Straw Hat Pirates (current); Sun Pirates (former); Ally of the Big Mom Pirates (former); Shichibukai (former); Ryugu Kingdom (resigned); Impel Down (former)]!~

Jinbe is a whale shark fishman who was the second captain of the Sunny Pirates after Fisher Tiger, and who became a Shichibukai eight years ago. Jinbe's name comes from jinbei-zame (甚平鮫), which means "whale shark" in Japanese. His epithet, Kaikyou would normally translate into "Strait" or "Channel". However since the kanji for it is written as (海侠の) and not (海峡の), the kyou part (侠) of it comes from (任侠), a honorific used when addressing a high ranking yakuza member, thus making his epithet a Japanese pun.

characters.name: 巴基
characters.description: 巴基是《海贼王》中的角色，巴基海贼团船长，外号小丑巴基，拥有醒目的红色圆鼻，吃下四分五裂果实，身体可以分离并受其控制，曾在罗杰海贼团当见习船员，与香克斯早年相识，擅长借势壮大声望，曾担任王下七武海，后来成为四皇之一。他早期在东海与路飞交手，之后因各种机缘卷入更大的海上事件。虽然常以夸张方式行事，却总能聚集追随者并不断提升名气。
traits: 身体可以分离并受其控制

__Height:__ 192 cm (6'3½")
__Affiliations:__ ~!Cross Guild; Buggy's Delivery (dissolved into Cross Guild); Buggy Pirates; Buggy and Alvida Alliance; Four Emperors; Seven Warlords of the Sea (disbanded); Roger Pirates (disbanded); Impel Down (former)!~ 
__Origin:__ Grand Line

__Devil Fruit:__ Bara Bara no Mi (Chop Chop Fruit)
__Devil Fruit Type:__ Paramecia
__Bounty:__ ~!3,189,000,000 (previously;15,000,000)!~

Buggy accidentally consumed the Bara Bara no Mi, (Chop Chop fruit) a Devil Fruit, which allows him to separate his body parts and control them independent of each other, but robbed him of the ability to swim. The abilities gained from this fruit also make Buggy immune to attacks from knives or swords; any such attack just separates him into his component parts.  In addition, most of his body is capable of flying through the air, fast enough to propel a man through a wall - with the crucial exception of his feet. However, even though the parts are separate, Buggy can still feel what the part feels (for example, when [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Monkey-D-Luffy) attacked Buggy, he separated his torso from his waist, only to find that Luffy was aiming for the crotch. Needless to say this left him with a rather painful result. Also when Buggy launched his hand out to pin down [Zoro](https://anilist.co/character/62/Roronoa-Zoro) for [Cabaji's](https://anilist.co/character/4897/Cabaji) Sting of the Unicycle Technique, Luffy stomped on it, inflicting tremendous pain). He also seems to require either a fixed distance from his detachments, or keep them within his line of vision, in order to manipulate them separately.  Besides his Devil fruit abilities he usually fights with three knives between his fingers. During the flashbacks of his youth he already used these three knives. He also has a blade hidden in his shoe and in Logue Town used a sword in his failed attempt to execute Luffy.

characters.name: 奈菲鲁塔丽·薇薇
characters.description: 奈菲鲁塔丽·薇薇是《海贼王》中的角色，阿拉巴斯坦王国公主，寇布拉的女儿，曾以星期三小姐为代号，潜入巴洛克工作社调查，与草帽一伙结成深厚友谊，致力于阻止故乡的内乱，有蓝色长发，重视国民的生命，在危险面前表现勇敢，最终选择留在阿拉巴斯坦。她为了查明威胁王国的阴谋，隐瞒身份进入巴洛克工作社。与路飞等人同行期间，她始终把人民的安危放在前面，努力拯救祖国。

source.description:
__Height__: 169 cm (5'6½”)
__Affiliation:__ Alabasta Royal Family (temporarily; Straw Hats Pirates) 
__Position:__ Princess of Alabasta  

Nefertari Vivi first appears as a member of Baroque Works, a criminal organization that was behind several scandals in the country of Alabasta, under the alias Miss Wednesday. It is revealed that Vivi is actually the princess of Alabasta, but infiltrated Baroque Works to find the identity of their leader, who turns out to be the Shichibukai member [Sir Crocodile](https://anilist.co/character/2749/Crocodile). With help from the Straw Hat Crew, she hopes to save her country from ruin.   

Vivi does not fit the stereotype of a needy and authoritative princess, never demanding any special attention or prioritizing herself above others. In fact, she usually puts the needs of others far above her own and is hesitant to rely on others or ask for help with her problems. In particular, she places an enormous value on the citizens of her country and the lives of her friends. She is also extremely brave and determined, going up against powerful enemies for her friends' sake, even when clearly outmatched. Her selflessness and sense of responsibility push her to carry her country's burden. She is slow to anger and quick to forgive but fiercely loyal to her friends, her family, and her country. Because of this loyalty and bravery, she is willing to make virtually any sacrifice to protect and serve them.

characters.name: 香克斯
characters.description: 香克斯是《海贼王》中的角色，红发海贼团船长，以红色头发闻名，是路飞童年的重要引路人，曾在罗杰海贼团当见习船员，将草帽托付给路飞，在救路飞时失去左臂，擅长使用霸气，拥有四皇地位，与巴基早年相识，期待路飞成为出色的海贼。他在风车村与年幼的路飞相识，用自己的行动影响了路飞的航海梦想。临别时交出的草帽成为两人重逢的约定，也是故事中的重要象征。

__Bounty:__ ~!4,048,900,000!~

Red-Haired Shanks is a legendary and powerful pirate in the Grand Line, being the captain of the Red-Haired Pirate Crew. Furthermore, he is [Monkey D. Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Monkey-D-Luffy)'s childhood hero. Overall, he is greatly respected by most of the characters, despite having a 'soft' and friendly nature and never appearing in actual combat ~!until he started a fight with [Whitebeard](https://anilist.co/character/2751/Edward-Newgate).!~ As a whole, he does not make many appearances in the series, although he appears in a majority of the opening or closing themes of the anime.  Shanks always wears a long black cape over his shoulders and until he met Luffy, wore a straw hat that he had worn for many years beforehand. He always wears trousers that are cut below the knee as well as a pair of sandals. The most striking thing about Shanks is the colour of his red hair, of which his nick-name 'Red Haired Shanks' comes from. ~!He also has three scars across his left eye, which were given to him by [Blackbeard](https://anilist.co/character/3331/Marshall-D-Teach) a long time ago.!~ He has a missing left arm, that he had lost when he saved Luffy from a Sea King. Shanks and his crew are almost always seen partying and drinking alcoholic beverages whenever they make an appearance as the Captain's favourite pastimes are attending and hosting parties and banquets.  According to [Oda](https://anilist.co/staff/96881/Oda-Eiichirou), Shanks is the one character that resembles himself the most out of all the One Piece characters, because of his fun-loving partying nature.

~!Shanks was a former member of Gol D. Roger's Crew and he became one of the Four Emperors 4 years before the beginning of the story (6 years before the timeskip)!~

characters.name: 波特卡斯·D·艾斯
characters.description: 波特卡斯·D·艾斯是《海贼王》中的角色，路飞的结义兄弟，白胡子海贼团第二队队长，曾吃下烧烧果实，能够操纵火焰，外号火拳艾斯，是哥尔·D·罗杰的儿子，与萨博一同在童年结义，十分珍惜自己的伙伴，追查黑胡子的行踪，顶上战争的核心人物。他虽然背负特殊身世，却在白胡子海贼团找到了归属。为了同伴与家人，他总是主动承担危险；他的命运也深刻改变了路飞的成长轨迹。
nicknames: ポートガス・D・エース
traits: 白胡子海贼团第二队队长

__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Devil Fruit:__ Mera Mera no Mi (Flame Flame Fruit)
__Devil Fruit Type:__ Logia
__Bounty:__ 550,000,000

One of the most obvious features on Ace is his tattoos. Ace's back tattoo is left intact in the English version of the dub despite 4Kids' previous edits to crosses. At the same time Ace also promotes his tattoo to [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Monkey-D-Luffy), something which is truly considered odd by 4Kids standards. Ace has a tattoo on his back of the Whitebeard symbol; a skull with a white mustache and a manji behind it. To avoid confusion between the two symbols and avoid slander for being a nazi, this was changed to crossbones in the shape of a "cross" in the anime, as well as in the most recent chapter of the manga.  Ace has another tattoo on his left arm by the shoulder: it reads "ASCE" with the "S" crossed out. ~!It serves as a symbol of his other deceased sworn brother Sabo.!~ In the English version of the anime, Ace's shoulder tattoo signifying his name is edited out, as he is referred to there as "Portgaz D. Trace." He appears in One Piece Grand Adventure, once again without the tattoo on his arm.  Ace travels around the Grand Line on his boat which is constructed so his Mera Mera no Mi fuels the engine on the rear end allowing it to move.  Currently, Ace is one of the two known pirates to ever escape arrest by the Marine captain [Smoker](https://anilist.co/character/2753/Smoker), the other escapee being Ace's younger brother Luffy. Ace and Smoker fought to a standstill in Alabasta.  He left Fuusha Village three years before Luffy, and he is a loyal crewman and commands the Second Division of [Whitebeard](https://anilist.co/character/2751/Edward-Newgate), his captain.  In appearance, the two brothers are obviously related, despite the fact that Ace is more muscular than the rather lanky Luffy. He also sports rather childish freckles. He is apparently narcoleptic (a trait common amongst Ace's family) and therefore falls asleep on random occasions, making people wonder if he has dropped dead. As far as personality goes, Ace is much more intelligent, polite, and generally more bearable than his younger brother, which prompts the Straw Hat crew to question whether he is truly related to their bumbling captain. However, the brothers themselves are very close, Ace portraying typical good-big-brother behaviors such as asking the crew to keep an eye on his little brother.

Crocodile is the leader of Baroque Works, a secret organization of assassins and spies, and a member of the Shichibukai. Utilizing Baroque Works, he incites rebellion in the kingdom of Alabasta in order to gain access to the Poneglyph hidden beneath the palace. He believes it will reveal the location of the weapon Pluton, which Crocodile wishes to gain control of in order to establish his military power. He is defeated by [Monkey D. Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Monkey-D-Luffy) and stripped of his Shichibukai status by the World Government, after which he is imprisoned. Crocodile ate the fictional Devil Fruit Suna Suna no Mi, giving him the ability to control sand, as well as avoid damage by turning into sand.

Edward Newgate, also known as Whitebeard, is the captain of the Whitebeard Pirates.

~!He is part of the Yonko, the 4 emperors of the New World, alongside [Big Mom](https://anilist.co/character/54495/Charlotte-Linlin), [Blackbeard](https://anilist.co/character/3331/Marshall-D-Teach), [Kaidou](https://anilist.co/character/46109/Kaidou) and [Red-Haired Shanks](https://anilist.co/character/727/Shanks). The Yonko are part of the San Dai Seiryoku, the Three Great Powers. The other two great powers are the Marine Headquarters and the Shichibukai, the seven warlords of the sea.

Whitebeard is said to be the strongest man in the world and the pirate closest to obtaining the legendary treasure, One Piece. It is said that Whitebeard used to have numerous battles with the late Pirate King, [Gol D. Roger](https://anilist.co/character/4883/Gold-Roger), and was marked as his equal in the past.

Whitebeard appears to have some health problems, possibly stemming from his advanced age or from his ferocious encounters with other great pirates during his earlier days. He is always surrounded by nurses and is hooked up to intravenous tubes. But despite this, he still drinks rum by (and directly from) the barrel. Even with his health issues, he is still considered the world's strongest pirate, which raises the question of how powerful he must have been in his prime.

He was a cheerful and carefree person during his younger years, prior to commanding his own ship and becoming known as Whitebeard. Due to being an orphan who grew up in poverty, Newgate has a strong desire for a family. In adulthood, unlike his comrades who loved treasure and riches, he only desired a family and saw that as the greatest treasure.!~

Blackbeard was formerly a member of the Whitebeard Pirates second division led by [Portgas D. Ace](https://anilist.co/character/2072/Portgas-D-Ace). [Shanks](https://anilist.co/character/727/Shanks) also warned [Whitebeard](https://anilist.co/character/2751/Edward-Newgate) that Blackbeard was becoming stronger than him and had only joined his crew to stay hidden behind the massive shadow of the Whitebeard name, until he became strong enough to make his move. This time came when Blackbeard murdered a member of the Whitebeard Pirates, thus prompting his departure from the crew, and Ace's hunt for him. Blackbeard was also the one who gave Shanks the scars around his eye, a long time ago. Shanks also tells Whitebeard to call back Ace on his hunt for Blackbeard, as he was concerned about the timing of a confrontation between Ace and Blackbeard.

characters.name: 宇智波鼬
characters.description: 宇智波鼬是《火影忍者》中的角色，宇智波佐助的兄长，宇智波一族成员，曾加入木叶暗部，后来成为晓组织成员，拥有写轮眼与万花筒写轮眼，精通幻术，常与干柿鬼鲛搭档行动，表面背负灭族罪名，对弟弟佐助有复杂而深厚的感情，其选择与木叶的政治危机有关。他长期以叛忍身份活动，使佐助一直把他视为复仇目标。随着真相逐渐揭开，鼬在家族、村子与弟弟之间所作的艰难决定成为故事的重要转折。

Itachi Uchiha is a missing-nin from Konohagakure, and a prominent member of Akatsuki, partnered with [Kisame Hoshigaki](https://anilist.co/character/2672). He is [Sasuke Uchiha](https://anilist.co/character/13)'s older brother.

Ever since his first appearance, Itachi had always been mysterious, and had acted as though he was hiding his true self. While flashbacks to his past showed that he was a compassionate brother and person, his later acts and claims made it seem that this was mostly just an act.

characters.name: 李洛克
characters.description: 李洛克是《火影忍者》中的角色，木叶隐村忍者，迈特凯的弟子，第三班成员，擅长体术，难以使用忍术和幻术，留着黑色西瓜头，穿绿色训练服，以努力弥补天赋限制，中忍考试中与我爱罗交战，重视伙伴并敬爱老师。他把成为优秀忍者的希望寄托在高强度训练上，证明即使不擅长忍术也能凭体术战斗。与我爱罗的比赛展现了他的毅力，也让同伴看见他的信念。

source.description:
Lee is a ninja affiliated with the village of Konohagakure, and is a member of Team Guy, which consists of himself, [Neji Hyuuga](https://anilist.co/character/1694), [Tenten](https://anilist.co/character/3710), and [Might Guy](https://anilist.co/character/307)—the team's leader.

Unable to use most ninja techniques, Lee dedicates himself to using solely taijutsu, ninja techniques similar to martial arts. Lee dreams of becoming a "splendid ninja" despite his inabilities.

characters.name: 迈特凯
characters.description: 迈特凯是《火影忍者》中的角色，木叶隐村上忍，第三班指导老师，李洛克的体术老师，留着黑色西瓜头，常穿绿色紧身训练服，擅长体术与八门遁甲，把卡卡西视为竞争对手，常强调青春与努力，关心弟子的成长，在大战中承担艰难战斗。他以热情和严格训练引导李洛克、宁次与天天，在实战中也总是挺身保护后辈。虽然举止夸张，他的体术实力和对弟子的责任心都十分突出。

source.description:
__Height__: 184 cm  
__Rank__: Jonin  

He is the leader of Team Guy, consisting of [Rock Lee](https://anilist.co/character/306/Lee-Rock), [Neji Hyuga](https://anilist.co/character/1694/Hyuuga-Neji), and [Tenten](https://anilist.co/character/3710/Tenten).  Guy, and by extension Lee, lives his life by his own "My Rules" philosophy, which involves setting tougher self-imposed penalties for failure so something good comes of it. For example, he vowed to walk 500 laps around Konoha on his hands if he lost a contest with [Kakashi](https://anilist.co/character/85/Hatake-Kakashi), and proceeded to do so upon losing, even though people eventually stopped paying attention. He also doesn't hesitate to do things he doesn't enjoy or that others might find embarrassing if it means his own self-improvement, as seen with his belief that one cannot dislike food regardless of its ingredients or taste. In addition, Guy values his youth to a great degree and dislikes the idea that he may not be as young as he once was. To help remedy this problem he spends large amounts of time with his younger teammates, hoping to acquire some of their youthful properties. Likewise, he often refers to himself as "Konoha's Noble Green Beast".  Guy is the self-proclaimed rival of Kakashi Hatake. Kakashi, however, is indifferent to their rivalry, which annoys Guy to no end. Kakashi also seems to have a habit of unintentionally ignoring Guy when Guy is lecturing him, which usually results in Guy asking himselif why Kakashi "has to act so cool". Guy randomly challenges Kakashi to contests of skill, and has acquired a record of 50 wins and 49 losses in doing so.

characters.name: 我爱罗
characters.description: 我爱罗是《火影忍者》中的角色，砂隐村忍者，四代风影的儿子，手鞠与勘九郎的弟弟，幼年体内封有守鹤，能够操纵沙子攻防，额头有爱字印记，曾因孤独而残酷，中忍考试中与鸣人交战，后来成为第五代风影，逐渐学会信任与守护同伴。他曾因被村民畏惧而与周围人隔绝，早期战斗方式十分凶狠。与鸣人交手后开始改变，后来承担风影职责，努力保护砂隐村与忍者同盟。
traits: 中忍考试中与鸣人交战
逐渐学会信任与守护同伴

source.description:
__Height:__ 146 cm

Gaara was introduced in the series in Chuunin Exams arc, as a violent shinobi from Konoha's allied country, the Wind country. He came to Konoha with his siblings [Temari](https://anilist.co/character/2174) and [Kankuro](https://anilist.co/character/4694), and with his mentor [Baki](https://anilist.co/character/15081), to participate in Chuunin exams.

~!From the first look, he was shown as merciless and violent individual. Due to his hard childhood, and lack of love, Gaara grew up hating everybody around him, loving only himself.   In fateful incident about 6 years before the main story time, he made himself a tattoo of Japanese Kanji letter "Ai", which stands for "Love". In Gaara's case, that Love was for himself, as he was "Demon loving only himself".  Gaara's point of view dramatically changed after a clash with [Naruto](https://anilist.co/character/17), who taught him the true meaning of loving others. Since then, Gaara always feels in debt to Naruto, and tries to help him as much as he can.  Like Naruto, Gaara is a Jinchuuriki who holds within him the one tailed beast, [Ichibi no Shukaku](https://anilist.co/character/11813). Gaara also relates to Naruto in that in his early years, Gaara was often repelled by other children, and feared by Suna's citizens due to the incredible power he possessed.!~

characters.name: 日向宁次
characters.description: 日向宁次是《火影忍者》中的角色，木叶隐村忍者，日向一族分家成员，第三班成员，拥有白眼，擅长柔拳，是日向雏田的堂兄，早期受宗家分家制度束缚，中忍考试中与鸣人交战，得到迈特凯指导，逐渐重新理解命运与自我选择。他在分家的处境中长大，曾相信人的命运无法改变。与鸣人交战后，他开始重新看待自己的道路，并在队伍里以出色的观察和近战能力帮助同伴。

Neji Hyuuga is a stoic member of [Might Guy](https://anilist.co/character/307)'s Team Guy, consisting of himself, [Rock Lee](https://anilist.co/character/306), and [Tenten](https://anilist.co/character/3710). Neji and Lee have somewhat of a rivalry, much like that of Guy and [Kakashi Hatake](https://anilist.co/character/85). Lee is determined to prove that a "failure" such as himself can defeat a "genius" such as Neji. Neji, however, doesn't seem to be interested in this goal of Lee's, and Lee doesn't seem to have made an effort to prove the point to Neji. Despite this apparent clashing of ideals between the two, Neji seems to get along fairly well with Tenten, with the latter often helping Neji with his training. Neji and Tenten also tend to share opinions on Lee and Guy's overreactive behaviors, often wondering how they can train the way they do.

As a member of the Hyuuga clan, Neji possesses the Byakugan, allowing him to see the chakra flow of others and block the flow upon contact with his Gentle Fist style. As a member of the clan's branch house, Neji can never hope to be taught how to use the clan's most secret techniques by the clan's elders. Despite this, Neji has learned many of the clan's strongest techniques independently, even creating a few unique skills of his own. Because of this, Neji is known as a genius ninja and graduated from the Academy as the #1 rookie.

~!Because his father, [Hizashi Hyuuga](https://anilist.co/character/22880), was a member of a branch house of the Hyuuga clan, Neji was born into the branch house. As a result, he was branded with the Hyuuga branch family seal at a young age so that the members of the main house could keep him in check. Hizashi, believing Neji to be denied his potential as a branch house member, openly resented the main house, causing Neji to acquire the same feelings due to his father's influence. In time, Neji's hatred for the main house would increase exponentially as result of Hizashi being sacrificed to save the life of [Hiashi Hyuuga](https://anilist.co/character/15039), Hizashi's twin brother. Neji believed that his father was forced to die for his twin brother. Because of this, Neji came to feel that fate was something decided at birth and that no matter what one does, people cannot escape their destiny. This idea would go on to shape Neji's life, creating a deep hatred for the main house and all of its members.!~

~!After the Chunnin Exams when Neji fights Naruto, both his great skill and potential are recognized by the clan leader, his uncle Hiashi Hyuuga, and is sought out by him to train with the main branch of the family to further enhance Neji's skills. This helps ease some of the tensions between the two branches of the Hyuuga clan.!~

characters.name: 奈良鹿丸
characters.description: 奈良鹿丸是《火影忍者》中的角色，木叶隐村忍者，第十班成员，奈良一族成员，能够操纵影子，擅长制定战术，常说麻烦，与丁次和井野是队友，中忍考试后晋升中忍，师从猿飞阿斯玛，面对危机时能冷静指挥。他平时显得懒散，却拥有出色的分析能力，总能在复杂战斗中找到突破口。阿斯玛的教导对他影响很深，他后来也逐渐承担起保护同伴的责任。

__Height:__ 170 cm
__Rank:__ Genin (I); Chuunin (II); ~!Hokage (III)!~

Shikamaru is an extremely unenthusiastic person, and as such lives his life avoiding work. This is partly due to him seeking paths of least resistance, as he often chooses to do things he would otherwise not do if people nag him enough. In his free time he typically takes naps, watches clouds, and plays strategy games such as Shogi and Go. When put into a situation where he potentially needs to put effort into something, he attempts to try to find a way to avoid it such as forfeiting a battle or by pretending to be preoccupied with something else. In the instances where he can not avoid these situations, Shikamaru tends to remark "how troublesome."

Despite his lazy tendencies, Shikamaru is extremely intelligent. His teacher, [Asuma](https://anilist.co/character/4775/Sarutobi-Asuma), found Shikamaru to have an IQ of over 200, and learned that Shikamaru's poor grades were a result of him finding lifting a pencil to be too much work for him. Nevertheless, Shikamaru works very well with his teammates, as their fathers were teamed together in their youth.

One of Shikamaru's more distinctive characteristics is that he finds all women to be bossy and "a pain." Contrary to this opinion, he has expressed a notably mature interest in marriage and raising a family with a son and daughter. Ironically, Shikamaru seems to constantly find himself surrounded by the very same strong-willed and bossy women he dislikes. In addition to his own [mother](https://anilist.co/character/22247/Nara-Yoshino), and being surrounded by bossy females, he usually ends up fighting against such women. Shikamaru has had a number of his appearances coincide with those of [Temari](https://anilist.co/character/2174/Temari). When they make their Part II debut together, [Naruto Uzumaki](https://anilist.co/character/17/Uzumaki-Naruto) asks if they are on a date, though both Shikamaru and Temari state that this is not the case.

When the need arises, Shikamaru is quick to abandon his lazy nature and act appropriately to complete a mission or save his teammates. Using his Shadow Imitation Technique, the signature technique of his clan, he can capture the shadow of an opponent to either keep them immobilized or force them to mimic his movements.

characters.name: 秋道丁次
characters.description: 秋道丁次是《火影忍者》中的角色，木叶隐村忍者，第十班成员，秋道一族成员，是鹿丸的童年好友，十分重视食物，使用倍化之术，能够通过体型变化战斗，师从猿飞阿斯玛，珍视同伴的信任，在追击佐助的任务中迎战次郎坊。他常因体型受到误解，但鹿丸始终相信他的能力。加入阿斯玛带领的第十班后，他把家族秘术用于保护朋友，在关键时刻能够展现坚强的一面。

__Height__: 156.3 cm (I); 172.3 cm (II)  

Chouji Akimichi is a childhood friend of Shikamaru Nara. Together with him Ino Yamanaka, and Asuma Sarutobi they make team 10. Chouji has a love for food, his favorite being Korean barbecue, general snacks and sweets, and basically anything that is edible. His nigh-constant hunger is a constant annoyance for his teammates, as sating himself often comes before other necessities such as stealth and teamwork. Because of this, his teammates often use food against him, such as offering him food as a reward for accomplishing a task or simply using his favorite foods as a form of blackmail. Despite his open display for his love of food, Chouji is very sensitive about his size and becomes highly agitated when somebody calls him "fat". Once called "fat", Chouji's resolve to fight is elevated to new levels and he becomes much more hostile to his opponents than he would otherwise. Just as they use food against him, Chouji's teammates use this personality trait against him as well. Should Chouji be reluctant to fight, one of them need only comment on his size to spur him into combat form.  As an Akimichi, Chouji's style of combat focuses on increasing his size. At the series' start he uses Multi-Size Technique to serve this purpose, reshaping him into a large, round form.

characters.name: 山中井野
characters.description: 山中井野是《火影忍者》中的角色，木叶隐村忍者，第十班成员，山中一族成员，擅长心转身之术，与鹿丸和丁次组队，与春野樱从小相识，曾与小樱在中忍考试对战，师从猿飞阿斯玛，可用精神系忍术支援同伴，继承家族的花店背景。她性格直率，早年与小樱既是朋友也有竞争关系。在第十班的合作中，她发挥山中一族的精神系秘术，为队友提供侦查与战术上的帮助。

Ino Yamanaka is a childhood friend of [Sakura Haruno](https://anilist.co/character/145/Haruno-Sakura) who was bullied due to her large forehead, ending when Ino befriended her. She acted like a mentor, being tougher and more confident. Under her influence, Sakura began to develop her own identity.

characters.name: 海野伊鲁卡
characters.description: 海野伊鲁卡是《火影忍者》中的角色，木叶忍者学校教师，鸣人的早期老师，在九尾袭击中失去父母，脸上有横向伤疤，真诚关心学生，最早认可鸣人的努力，曾阻止水木的阴谋，在鸣人成长过程中提供支持，擅长基础忍术教学，重视村子里的孩子。他经历过九尾带来的伤痛，却没有把怨恨投向鸣人。正是他的认可与保护，让长期被排斥的鸣人第一次感到自己被当作一个人接纳。

Iruka Umino is an instructor at the Ninja Academy, characterized by the distinctive scar across his face that he has had since childhood. The name "Umino Iruka" can be taken as "umi no iruka" ("sea dolphin").   Twelve to thirteen years ago, the [Nine-Tailed Demon Fox](https://anilist.co/character/7407/Kurama) attacked Konoha, killing many people. Iruka's parents were still out fighting the Fox and were killed. Iruka was dragged back for protection by an unknown ninja but wanted to stay where he was. After it was over, everyone in the Ninja Academy made fun of him and made him feel just like [Naruto Uzumaki](https://anilist.co/character/17/Uzumaki-Naruto).

characters.name: 手鞠
characters.description: 手鞠是《火影忍者》中的角色，砂隐村忍者，我爱罗的姐姐，勘九郎的姐姐，使用大型铁扇作战，擅长风遁忍术，中忍考试期间来到木叶，早期与奈良鹿丸交手，性格干练而直接，关心弟弟我爱罗的变化，后来参与木叶与砂隐的合作。她作为砂隐队伍的重要成员，以远距离风遁攻击见长。经历中忍考试与村子间的冲突后，她逐渐与木叶忍者建立联系，也见证我爱罗的成长。

__Height:__ 165 cm

Temari is the oldest child of the [Fourth Kazekage](https://anilist.co/character/22920/Rasa), making her the older sister of [Gaara](https://anilist.co/character/1662/Gaara) and [Kankuro](https://anilist.co/character/4694/Kankuro).

Temari is generally overbearing, if not crude, toward those around her, often not being afraid to speak her mind. One of the few things shown to intimidate her is her younger brother Gaara. She very rarely stays true to her normally tough, demanding attitude, when around the boy, due to the fear of Gaara's wrath. Temari does have a caring side, and is not above showing concern for others. She is often seen with [Shikamaru](https://anilist.co/character/2007/Nara-Shikamaru). Temari is a keen analyst, and can easily deduce an opponent's strategies and weaknesses soon after a battle begins.

For actual combat she uses her giant iron fan that, in addition to serving as a makeshift club, can be used to glide upon in order to intimidate her foes. She likes sweet chestnuts and kenchin soup.

characters.name: 大蛇丸

traits: 木叶传说中的三忍之一

characters.description: 柯尼·斯普林格是《进击的巨人》中的角色，第104期训练兵团成员，出身拉加哥村，后来加入调查兵团，行动敏捷，与萨莎关系亲近，性格直率活跃，十分在意家人的安危，经历故乡村民变故，参与多次墙外作战，与艾伦等人并肩作战。他早期常以轻松的话语活跃队伍气氛，但巨人与战争使他逐渐面对沉重的失去。即使遭遇故乡的灾难，他仍与同伴一起承担危险任务。

source.description:
__Height__: 158 cm (5'2")  
__Relatives:__ [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/137287/Conny-no-Haha), Martin Springer (Brother), Sunny Springer (Sister)

Connie Springer is a graduate of the 104th Training Corps, having ranked 8th in class. He is known to be one of the quickest soldiers while using ODM gear and is skilled at making very sharp turns. He hails from the rural Ragako Village within Wall Rose, his greatest ambition being to make his family and village proud of him. Upon graduation, he chose to join the Survey Corps. 

Upbeat and naive, Connie is rather unfocused outside of combat, and enjoys goofing around and messing with his friends, but can also be a bit dense at times, as he can have some difficulty comprehending new developments as they appear. Connie always tries to remain optimistic, consistently caring for the well-being of his friends, family and village, and being willing to help in any way he can. However, this soft spot and the struggles he goes through as a member of the Survey Corps takes a toll on him, as he often responds to grief and loss with anger, irritation and hatred, causing him to at times make rash, impulsive decisions. He will do anything to protect his family, whether it be his biological family or his closest friends.

characters.name: 贝尔托特·胡佛
characters.description: 贝尔托特·胡佛是《进击的巨人》中的角色，第104期训练兵团成员，身材高大，性格寡言而谨慎，与莱纳从小相识，拥有超大型巨人之力，来自马莱，曾与同伴一同混入墙内，破坏城墙的事件与他有关，在任务与友情之间矛盾，是墙内外冲突的关键人物。他看起来温和沉默，常站在莱纳身旁，实际背负着秘密任务。随着身份暴露，他不得不直面昔日同期生，战斗也揭示了双方难以调和的处境。

Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Bertoldt ranked 3rd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881) and his hometown friend [Reiner](https://anilist.co/character/46484). A member of the 104th Southern Division in the Cadet Corps. After graduating from the 104th, ranked 4th place in the top 10, she ends up joining the Military Police. She is roommates with [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017).

source.description:
__Height__: 175 cm (5'8")
__Relatives__: [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131444/Jean-no-Haha)

Jean Kirschtein is a graduate of the 104th Cadet Corps, among whom he ranked 6th for his skills with ODM gear and ability to look at things through a more tactical lense. Jean hails from Wall Rose's Trost District, and joined the military with hopes of living a peaceful life within the walls as part of the Military Police. However, he would later find himself joining the Survey Corps after being convinced both by his close friend [Marco Bott's](https://anilist.co/character/62479/Marco-Bott) words, and after witnessing the death of several of his comrades.

Jean has a blunt personality. He holds no restraint when it comes to speaking his mind, even when he knows it would not be wise to do so or when it could spark conflict. Jean is also pragmatic: he has a strong aversion to exposing himself to dangerous situations. During his time as a cadet, Jean was extremely hot-headed, easily becoming frustrated and quick to resort to violence when pushed. Jean was also very cynical about defeating the Titans, believing that humanity has no chance against them and openly mocking more idealistic individuals like [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager), and saw resisting the Titans as a hopeless cause. However, despite these things, and although he presents himself as self-centered, Jean places high value on the lives of his comrades, and is willing to risk his life to prevent countless more deaths from his comrades. Even with his shortcomings, Jean has shown himself to be a natural leader, being able to understand others and assess situations well because of his flaws, and proves capable of leading his fellow soldiers when they are left confused and without a plan.

Father of [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and caretaker of [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman). He is a renowned doctor who was well respected in the District of Shiganshina after he saved the village from a mysterious viral epidemic by developing vaccines. He also provides a medical house call service to the people of Shiganshina and to various towns in addition to having a network of contacts within the Corps of the Shiganshina District. He is married to [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475).

~!In the basement of the Yeager family house, he hides a secret which he refers to as the "truth". Upon finding Eren after the fall of Wall Maria, he injects him with a series of chemicals and amnesiacs and entrusts him with the key to the "truth", before mysteriously disappearing. This strange serum resulted in Eren gaining the ability to transform into a titan.!~

source.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Soldier, Special Operations Squad.
__Relatives:__ [Father](https://anilist.co/character/131987/Petra-no-Chichi)

Petra Ral is a soldier of the Survey Corps hand-picked by [Captain Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) to join the Special Operations Squad.

Petra is a very kind and caring woman, going out of her way to look after and guiding [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) when he was first admitted to the squad. She seemed to have the most attachment to Eren among Levi Squad, as she was often the only one shown to actually worry about him and his wellbeing, at least at first. Although all of Levi's squad wished for Eren's unconditional trust, it was ultimately Petra who convinced him to do so. 

Despite her kind nature, Petra was a conditioned soldier with a quick reaction time against perceived danger. She displays extreme loyalty to her leaders, superiors and their orders, and cares deeply for her team, although she tends to be at odds with [Oluo Bozad](https://anilist.co/character/71687/Oluo-Bozard) due to his irritating tendency to try and imitate Levi. She greatly looks up to Levi as her superior and is deeply devoted to him, willing to completely dedicate her life to his cause. It is implied that she may harbor romantic feelings for her captain.

Class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School

Tenya may look severe, but he's actually just a very serious person, who takes everything, even the most insignificant thing, seriously. A testament to his generally hyperactive and intense behavior, Tenya often exhibits plenty of peculiar tics, such as moving his arms around in strange chopping patterns or sometimes twitching his body uncontrollably. Tenya is very humble, willing to admit to his mistakes, apologize for rude behavior, and improve in areas he lacks. Being part of the highly-esteemed Ida Family of Heroes, Tenya is proud of his lineage and works hard to meet his expectations. He greatly admires his older brother, [Tensei](https://anilist.co/character/129757/Iida-Tensei) (also known as the Turbo Hero: Ingenium), and aspires to become a similar hero.

Tenya's Quirk Engine gives him car-like engines in each of his calves, giving him incredible running speed and extreme kicking power. Tenya needs to fuel his engines by drinking orange juice. Tenya's engines have multiple gears; it is currently unknown how many, but it has been implied that there are more than three.

Vice class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School. She was admitted to the school through official recommendations. 

Momo is a very prudent, dedicated person who acts as a natural leader. She is generally level-headed and calm in dangerous situations, but she isn't above falling into a panic. Momo's Quirk gives her the ability to create any non-living material/object from her exposed skin by transforming the molecular structure of her fat cells. In order to create something, she needs to understand the molecular structure of which the material/object is made.

characters.name: 切岛锐儿郎
characters.description: 切岛锐儿郎是《我的英雄学院》中的角色，雄英高中一年级A班学生，英雄名烈怒赖雄斗，拥有硬化个性，可以强化身体防御，留着醒目的红色尖发，与爆豪胜己关系亲近，崇敬英雄红赖雄斗，重视男子汉气概，面对危险愿意保护朋友，在实战中不断提升硬化能力。他性格开朗，常主动帮助同班同学，尤其重视勇气与信义。曾经对自己的胆怯感到懊悔，因此立志成为能在关键时刻挺身而出的英雄。
nicknames: Gouken Hero: Red Riot (剛健ヒーロー 烈怒頼雄斗)
traits: 雄英高中一年级A班学生
面对危险愿意保护朋友
在实战中不断提升硬化能力

name_alternative: Gouken Hero: Red Riot (剛健ヒーロー 烈怒頼雄斗)
source.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Quirk:__ Hardening

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Eijiro is a boisterous and outgoing guy with a fondness for manliness, often using the terms "manly" and "unmanly" to describe things and people he does or doesn't like, respectively. Eijiro is very honest and kind-hearted, having a straightforward way of thinking and following a specific code of chivalry that motivates him to live without regret. He is determined and selfless, bravely putting the safety of others before himself. He is also a big fan of Crimson Riot, a retro hero from whom he takes inspiration, including personal values and his hero name. Although Eijiro may not be as hot-blooded and competitive as [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892), he does not shy away from comparing himself to him, with [Izuku](https://anilist.co/character/89028) stating that the two have managed to develop a relationship between equals. As a result, Eijiro is notably one of the few people that Katsuki holds in higher esteem.

Eijiro's Quirk gives him the power to harden and sharpen any or all parts of his body, causing his flesh to become jagged and rock-like. There is a limit to how much damage his hardened body can withstand, which causes the Hardening itself to slowly dissipate, and Eijiro to lose stamina from struggling to keep his Quirk active.

characters.name: 芦户三奈
characters.description: 芦户三奈是《我的英雄学院》中的角色，雄英高中一年级A班学生，拥有酸液个性，可以分泌并控制酸液，皮肤呈粉红色，头上有角状突起，性格活泼善于交友，擅长舞蹈，与切岛锐儿郎有旧识，能够用酸液辅助移动与战斗，参加雄英体育祭。她在班里常带动气氛，也愿意在同学遇到困难时给予支持。酸液个性既能用于攻击，也能配合灵活的身法进行回避，展现多样的实战用途。
traits: 雄英高中一年级A班学生
能够用酸液辅助移动与战斗

source.description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3")
__Quirk:__ Acid

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Mina is a cheerful and easygoing girl who usually displays a smile. Highly social and excitable, she loves to hang out with her friends and is shown to become very upset when denied an opportunity to be at a gathering. She possesses a strong fashion sense and likes to go shopping. Due to her athleticism and energy, Mina enjoys and is very skilled at dancing. Mina is extremely courageous and is viewed as an ideal personality for hero work.

Mina's Quirk Acid allows her to produce a corrosive liquid from her body. She can control the solubility and viscosity of this corrosive liquid. There is a limit to how long she can produce the corrosive liquid until her skin gradually loses its natural resistance to it. Overusing her Quirk or pushing it too far can also be fatal, as it dehydrates her body very fast. Mina can use her acid offensively, but has shown utility with it as well, such as melting handholds for herself to climb with. She is also known to secrete a non-corrosive version of the acid from her feet in order to slide around.

characters.name: 上鸣电气
characters.description: 上鸣电气是《我的英雄学院》中的角色，雄英高中一年级A班学生，拥有带电个性，可以释放电流，使用支援装备控制放电方向，金色头发上有黑色闪电状纹路，性格外向，与同班同学关系活跃，过度放电会暂时影响思考能力，常参与团队作战，希望成长为可靠英雄。他能在大范围战斗中释放强力电击，但需要注意避免波及队友。随着训练推进，他学习借助装备精确控制能力，在团队中发挥更稳定的作用。
nicknames: Stun Gun Hero: Chargezuma (スタンガンヒーロー・チャージズマ)
traits: 雄英高中一年级A班学生
使用支援装备控制放电方向

source.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")
__Quirk:__ Electrification

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Denki is a friendly, social, and energetic boy who enjoys hanging out with others. He is rather casual when interacting with other people, including the generally unfriendly [Katsuki Bakugou](https://anilist.co/character/88892/Bakugou-Katsuki). 

Denki's Quirk Electrification allows him to store and discharge electricity. While he can also discharge this energy over a distance, Denki has little to no control over it, meaning it will go everywhere indiscriminately. Denki is also able to absorb and neutralize electricity and other lightning-based Quirks. Whenever Denki exceeds his wattage limit, he loses his ability to discharge energy, with his entire personality changing into that of a giggling idiot for a certain period until he reverts to normal. In this state, he is always giving thumbs-ups as a way to let others know that he is okay.

characters.name: 耳郎响香
characters.description: 耳郎响香是《我的英雄学院》中的角色，雄英高中一年级A班学生，拥有耳机插孔个性，耳垂能延伸出插头状器官，能够感知细微声音，可把心跳音转化为攻击，喜爱音乐与演奏，常使用吉他，性格直率而稍显害羞，与上鸣电气经常互动，在文化祭中组织乐队演出。她兼具侦查和攻击能力，在团队作战中常通过声音探测周围情况。音乐是她重要的兴趣，文化祭表演也让她学会把个人爱好带给更多同学。
traits: 雄英高中一年级A班学生

source.description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")
__Quirk:__ Earphone Jack
__Affiliation:__ U.A. High School
__Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged + Support Combat

Kyoka is a petite, fair-skinned girl with a slender build. She has triangular, lazy-looking onyx eyes with notably long lower eyelashes, and rather small eyebrows. Kyoka has a pragmatic, unenthusiastic and teasing personality that is mostly shown to those she finds irritating. Kyoka is not always like this though, as she does enjoy socializing with others, in which case she is usually nice and friendly. Kyoka's Quirk (Earphone Jack) allows her to plug the jacks that hang from her earlobes into all sorts of things and channel the sound of her heartbeat into them; causing havoc inside the plugged objects. It's also used to catch sounds and vibrations from her surroundings.

characters.name: 常暗踏阴
characters.description: 常暗踏阴是《我的英雄学院》中的角色，雄英高中一年级A班学生，有鸟类外形的头部，拥有黑影个性，能让黑影离体作战，黑暗环境会增强黑影，强光能抑制黑影，性格沉稳而富有诗意，曾接受霍克斯指导，重视对能力失控的控制，在班级战斗中负责攻防配合。他通过黑影进行远距离攻击、防御和移动，但能力会随光照条件变化。为了成为真正可靠的英雄，他持续训练自己与黑影的配合和控制力。
nicknames: Shikkoku Hero: Tsukuyomi (漆黒ヒーロー ツクヨミ)
traits: 雄英高中一年级A班学生
重视对能力失控的控制
在班级战斗中负责攻防配合

source.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm
__Quirk:__ Dark Shadow

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Fumikage is reserved, serious, and focused, albeit noble and valiant. Though not talkative, Fumikage will directly ignore questions or requests that seem in some way pointless. During combat, Fumikage is known to be fierce and dependable, with his strength and capabilities rarely being questioned. Fumikage is fond of darkness and other related concepts, considering himself a "creature of the dark" and employing archaic-sounding speeches that paint him slightly creepy or dramatic. 

Fumikage's Quirk "Dark Shadow" allows him to manifest a sentient shadow monster from his body that he can materialize and contract freely. Dark Shadow's energy is limited and can be drained by bright light. Dark Shadow retracts into Fumikage's body when it runs out of energy. The shadow entity's personality, strength, defense, and control depend on the lack of light. In bright light, Dark Shadow is weaker and smaller but still has considerable strength and defense and is easier to control, but in total darkness, Dark Shadow's size and parameters are drastically enhanced. It is powerful enough to rip out and cut down multiple full-grown trees easily. However, Dark Shadow is more difficult to control in the dark, causing it to rampage based on its own free will.

characters.name: 叶隐透
characters.description: 叶隐透是《我的英雄学院》中的角色，雄英高中一年级A班学生，拥有透明化个性，身体长期保持不可见，能够利用隐身接近目标，性格开朗活泼，在班级活动中积极参与，行动时常通过服装显示位置，能力适合潜入与侦查，与同学合作发挥隐蔽优势，希望成为职业英雄。虽然外表难以被看见，她在同学之间一直保持活跃的存在感。透明化能力让她适合执行隐蔽行动，也促使她在训练中寻找更有效的战术。
nicknames: Stealth Hero: Invisible Girl (ステルスヒーロー インビジブルガール)
traits: 雄英高中一年级A班学生

source.description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")
__Quirk:__ Invisibility 

Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.

Tooru is a bubbly, cheery, and easygoing girl who does most things with an upbeat attitude. She is very socially eager and likes shopping, and her room suggests that she likes plushies and other cute things.

Tooru's Quirk is that her body is completely invisible. In addition to the stealth capabilities granted to her by her invisible body, Tooru can refract light that passes through her, allowing her to intensify the light into a blinding flash. She has further refined this application of her Quirk, achieving the ability to manipulate and redirect light-based attacks, such as [Yuuga Aoyama](https://anilist.co/character/127042/Aoyama-Yuuga)'s Navel Laser.

characters.name: All For One
characters.description: All For One是《我的英雄学院》中的角色，反派组织的重要首领，拥有夺取他人个性的能力，可把个性赋予其他人，与欧尔麦特长期对立，培养死柄木弔，通过多种个性组合战斗，长期隐藏身份与布局，与敌联盟发展有关，对英雄社会构成重大威胁，追求扩大自身统治力量。他凭借名为All For One的能力夺取并分配个性，长期在暗处影响反派势力。与欧尔麦特的对抗贯穿多代英雄，他对死柄木的培养也改变了后续局势。
nicknames: オール・フォー・ワン
traits: 拥有夺取他人个性的能力

source.name_native: オール・フォー・ワン
source.description:
__Quirk:__ All For One
__Occupation:__ Villain
__Fighting Style:__ Close Range and Long Range

All For One is the true leader and benefactor of the League of Villains. Once Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis, his true motives are unclear and his true identity unknown. His current goal is to raise Shigaraki to become his eventual successor.

characters.name: 贝姬·布莱克贝尔
characters.description: 贝姬·布莱克贝尔是《间谍过家家》中的角色，伊甸学园学生，阿尼亚的好友，布莱克贝尔家族成员，父亲经营军工企业，与阿尼亚同在塞西尔宿舍，性格活泼直率，常帮助阿尼亚适应学校生活，喜欢浪漫电视剧，对洛伊德抱有孩童式憧憬，重视与阿尼亚的友谊。她出身富裕家庭，却真心把阿尼亚当作朋友，常在学校里陪伴并支持她。与阿尼亚相处时，她的天真、好胜和体贴都展露出来。
nicknames: ベッキー・ブラックベル
traits: 与阿尼亚同在塞西尔宿舍

source.name_native: ベッキー・ブラックベル
source.description:
__Affiliation:__ Blackbell Family, Blackbell Heavy Industries, Eden Academy, Cecile Hall
__Occupation:__ Student

The daughter of the CEO of Blackbell, a major military manufacturer. Attends Eden Academy as part of Cecil House, Group 3. Best friends with [Anya Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Forger-Anya).

Becky is a very kind child but with her being the daughter of a major military manufacturer, she is shown to be somewhat prideful and tries to be mature, attempting to take Anya under her wing as an act of benevolence when she views Anya as a brat. She does not attempt to get close to [Damian Desmond](https://anilist.co/character/150424/Desmond-Damian) despite his social position, even looking down on their classmates who try to befriend Damian and Anya who is initially bullied by Damian's group. Anya's confident smile later wins over Becky's admiration.

characters.name: 达米安·德斯蒙
characters.description: 达米安·德斯蒙是《间谍过家家》中的角色，伊甸学园学生，德斯蒙家族次子，多诺万·德斯蒙的儿子，与阿尼亚同班，常与埃米尔和尤因同行，渴望得到父亲认可，表面骄傲好强，学习成绩优秀，与阿尼亚关系复杂，是黄昏接近目标家庭的关键人物。他在学园里表现出强烈的自尊心，内心却希望得到家人的关注。阿尼亚与他频繁发生误会，两人的互动也成为洛伊德执行任务的重要一环。
nicknames: ダミアン・デズモンド
traits: 常与埃米尔和尤因同行
是黄昏接近目标家庭的关键人物

source.name_native: ダミアン・デズモンド
source.description:
__Height:__ 110 cm (3′7″)
__Affiliation:__ Desmond Family, Eden Academy, Cecile Hall
__Occupation:__ Student

The second son of [Donovan Desmond](https://anilist.co/character/180192/Desmond-Donovan) and attends Eden Academy as part of Cecile House, Group 3.  

A young child with an arrogant and rude personality, caused by him being the second son of Donovan Desmond, the leader of the National Unity Party, a group important and powerful enough to threaten the peace between the East and the West. This has caused Damian to gain a highly respected status among his peers and making him incredibly arrogant, assuming [Anya](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Forger-Anya) gained a crush on him when she stared at him. He is shown to prefer being called Lord Damian when spoken to. He gets angry when he is looked down upon by Anya's smile, quickly resorting to insulting her with his limited vocabulary and harassing Anya.

characters.name: 西尔维娅·舍伍德
characters.description: 西尔维娅·舍伍德是《间谍过家家》中的角色，WISE情报人员，代号管理官，负责指挥黄昏，常以外交官身份掩护，安排枭计划相关任务，情报工作经验丰富，行事冷静严厉，重视维护东西两国和平，曾经历战争带来的失去，是洛伊德的重要上级。她负责向黄昏传达任务并协调情报网络，常以严厉态度确保行动顺利。战争经历使她格外清楚和平的价值，也让她在工作中保持坚定。
nicknames: シルヴィア・シャーウッド
traits: 重视维护东西两国和平
曾经历战争带来的失去

characters.name: 弗兰基·富兰克林
characters.description: 弗兰基·富兰克林是《间谍过家家》中的角色，黄昏的情报协助者，经营烟草店作为掩护，擅长搜集信息，能够制作与修理小型装置，有蓬松的卷发，常为洛伊德提供任务支援，与阿尼亚相识，性格幽默而爱抱怨，向往恋爱关系，在关键时刻可靠。他并非WISE正式特工，却经常为洛伊德提供情报、道具与临时协助。平时喜欢开玩笑或抱怨，真正需要帮忙时仍愿意冒险支持朋友。

__Height:__ 166 cm (5′5")
__Affiliation:__ Ostania
__Occupation:__ Tobacco Store Clerk (False Front), Informant, Soldier (formerly)

Franky is an informant who seemingly works at a tobacco store and presumably works for Loid Forger's agency. He gets information regarding Eden Academy's exam and Anya Forger's past records for Loid Forger.

Franky is a kind person willing to help Loid out when he's in a pinch even though the danger is high. He frequently warns Loid Forger not to get too close to other people in their line of work.

He frequently falls in love with other women but his love life typically fails due to lack of mutual interest or they are already with someone else.

characters.name: 亨利·亨德森
characters.description: 亨利·亨德森是《间谍过家家》中的角色，伊甸学园教师，担任塞西尔宿舍舍监，重视优雅的举止，参与新生入学面试，教导学生礼仪和历史，经常说出优雅一词，对学生的品格有要求，曾认可福杰一家的表现，面对不公愿意表达反对，关注学生的成长。他对学园传统和礼仪有很高要求，初看显得严苛，却能辨认学生与家长真正的品格。福杰一家入学面试中的行为让他留下深刻印象。

__Occupation:__ History Teacher, Housemaster of Cecile Hall

Henry is a mature and noble person, who places a high importance on "elegance". To him, elegance seems to be the way a person conducts themselves, and is not afraid to correct inelegant behavior in others.

characters.name: 桑岛慈悟郎
characters.description: 桑岛慈悟郎是《鬼灭之刃》中的角色，前鬼杀队鸣柱，我妻善逸的师父，曾指导狯岳修行，擅长雷之呼吸，退役后培育后辈剑士，对善逸寄予厚望，尽管善逸胆小仍不放弃他，担心弟子误入歧途，被善逸称作爷爷，其教导影响善逸的战斗方式。他在退役后持续传授雷之呼吸，对善逸与狯岳都投入心力。善逸最初缺乏自信，但慈悟郎始终相信弟子能够成长，成为善逸难忘的师长。

characters.name: 不死川玄弥
characters.description: 不死川玄弥是《鬼灭之刃》中的角色，鬼杀队剑士，风柱不死川实弥的弟弟，与炭治郎同期参加最终选拔，擅长使用火枪，无法掌握呼吸法，通过吞食鬼获得暂时力量，言行粗鲁但重视家人，与兄长关系紧张，参加刀匠村战斗，希望获得兄长的认可。他因家族经历与实弥之间产生深刻隔阂，表面上常显得急躁。进入鬼杀队后，他以独特方式对抗恶鬼，始终在意兄长的安危与评价。

Genya Is a Demon Hunter of the Demon Killing Corps. He is also the younger brother of the Wind Pillar [Sanemi Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137774).

~! Due to his lack of breath forms he is dependent on using his shotgun and demon form. His shotgun pelts are made from sun steel to be effective against demons. His demon form is active when he digests anything from a demon to gain demon like strength and abilities. He is the only demon hunter to have this ability given that it is drastically rare !~

characters.name: 伊黑小芭内
characters.description: 伊黑小芭内是《鬼灭之刃》中的角色，鬼杀队蛇柱，使用蛇之呼吸，常有白蛇镝丸相伴，口部缠着绷带，瞳色不同，战斗动作如蛇般灵活，对队伍纪律要求严格，关心甘露寺蜜璃，出身经历留下心理阴影，参与对抗鬼舞辻无惨。他表面严厉，对其他剑士的失误常不留情面，却对蜜璃抱有深厚感情。独特的剑术与白蛇伙伴让他在战斗中具备敏锐的判断能力。
traits: 出身经历留下心理阴影

source.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'3")

Obanai is a Demon Slayer and the Snake Pillar of the Demon Slayer Corps.

A young man of short stature and a pale complexion. He has straight-edged black hair of varying lengths, the longest reaching down to his shoulders and the shortest stopping at his cheekbones, which he wears down with two shorter strands hanging between his eyes. He wears a navy blue version of the standard Demon Slayer uniform, along with a black and white pinstriped haori, the hem and cuffs of which are striped lengthways rather than vertically, which covers his hands. Obanai also sports bandages in place of the leg-wraps around his calves, as well as another set of bandages that cover his mouth, and blue-strapped zori on his feet.

He is also always seen with his white snake, Kaburamaru, wrapped around his shoulders.

characters.name: 悲鸣屿行冥
characters.description: 悲鸣屿行冥是《鬼灭之刃》中的角色，鬼杀队岩柱，身材异常高大，双目失明，常手持念珠，使用岩之呼吸，以锁链连接武器战斗，过去曾照顾孤儿，性格慈悲而严厉，被视作柱中的强者，参加与上弦及无惨的决战。他曾因保护孩子遭遇悲剧，之后投入鬼杀队。虽然双眼无法视物，却凭训练与感知掌握极强的战斗能力，对后辈同样怀有深切关怀。
traits: 参加与上弦及无惨的决战

source.description:
__Height:__ 220 cm (7'2½")

He is a Demon Slayer and the Stone Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps. Gyomei also serves as the mentor of [Genya Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137776/Shinazugawa-Genya).

characters.name: 真菰
characters.description: 真菰是《鬼灭之刃》中的角色，鳞泷左近次的弟子，曾参加鬼杀队最终选拔，常穿带花纹的和服，佩戴狐狸面具，与锖兔相识，帮助炭治郎练习剑术，举止温柔，擅长分析战斗动作，与狭雾山的修行有关，曾遭手鬼杀害。她与锖兔在炭治郎的修行中给予帮助，指出他动作和呼吸中的不足。温和的指导让炭治郎逐渐掌握水之呼吸，也了解鳞泷弟子的往事。
traits: 曾参加鬼杀队最终选拔

source.description:
A cute and mysterious girl who wears a floral pattern kimono. Her fox mask has two flowers on its right cheek.

~!She is a former apprentice of [Sakonji Urokodaki](https://anilist.co/character/137773/Urokodaki-Sakonji).!~

characters.name: 产屋敷耀哉
characters.description: 产屋敷耀哉是《鬼灭之刃》中的角色，鬼杀队当主，产屋敷家族成员，被队士称作主公，患有家族遗传的疾病，身体逐渐衰弱，声音温和而有威信，统率各位柱，致力于消灭鬼舞辻无惨，关心鬼杀队成员，为对抗无惨制定计划。他身体虚弱，却以信任和远见团结鬼杀队。各位柱尊敬他的判断，他也始终记得牺牲的队士，把终结鬼舞辻无惨视作家族使命。
traits: 致力于消灭鬼舞辻无惨

source.description: He is the head of the Ubuyashiki Family and 97th leader of the Demon Slayer Corps known mainly as "Oyakata-sama" ("Master") by his subordinates and peers.

characters.name: 锖兔
characters.description: 锖兔是《鬼灭之刃》中的角色，鳞泷左近次的弟子，曾与富冈义勇一同修行，佩戴狐狸面具，擅长水之呼吸，帮助炭治郎练剑，在最终选拔中救助他人，与手鬼战斗时牺牲，性格严格而重视责任，对义勇有深刻影响，与真菰一起出现在炭治郎修行中。他在狭雾山以严厉的方式磨炼炭治郎，强调剑士应当具备真正的力量。生前保护同伴的行为，也长久影响富冈义勇与其他师门后辈。

在最终选拔中救助他人
与真菰一起出现在炭治郎修行中

characters.name: 愈史郎
characters.description: 愈史郎是《鬼灭之刃》中的角色，由珠世转化的鬼，与珠世共同生活，协助珠世研究药物，对珠世非常忠诚，能够使用血鬼术，可以制作隐蔽用的符咒，初见炭治郎时态度尖锐，不会随意伤害人类，参与对抗鬼舞辻无惨，擅长提供情报与支援。他因珠世获得新生，把守护她放在首位，因此对接近珠世的人常怀有警惕。随着鬼杀队合作推进，他的符咒与情报能力成为重要助力。
traits: 可以制作隐蔽用的符咒
初见炭治郎时态度尖锐

source.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")

Yushiro is a traveling companion of Tamayo and close ally of Kamado Tanjirou. He was turned into a Demon by Tamayo. Yushiro was a human who was under the care of Tamayo as she was practicing as a medical practitioner. He was in the frail state fighting disease when Tamayo gave him the choice of succumbing to his illness or to live longer as a Demon. He agreed to become a Demon and has since stayed by Tamayo's side serving as an assistant as well as her guard.
~!Yushiro would become the last known survivor of the Demon race. In time he would dedicate himself to a life of art and become a world famous painter in the present day under the name of Yushiro Yamamoto, known for his paintings of Tamayo to wide critical acclaim!~

characters.name: 日番谷冬狮郎
characters.description: 日番谷冬狮郎是《死神》中的角色，护廷十三队十番队队长，外形年轻，有银白色头发，持有斩魄刀冰轮丸，擅长冰雪系能力，性格认真冷静，与松本乱菊搭档，与雏森桃自幼相识，对部下有责任心，在蓝染事件中多次参战。他虽然年纪和外表都显得年轻，却凭实力担任队长。面对涉及雏森桃的阴谋时，他的情绪会受到影响，但仍努力承担队长职责。
traits: 护廷十三队十番队队长
在蓝染事件中多次参战

source.description:
__Height:__ 133 cm (4'4")
__Race:__ Shinigami
__Rank:__ Captain of the 10th Division
__Zanpakutou:__ [Hyourinmaru](https://anilist.co/character/25881/Hyourinmaru)

Hitsugaya comes from Junrinan, District 1 of Rukongai. There, he lived with an old woman (said to be his grandmother), Momo Hinamori, and possibly other people. Little else is known about his past, but it is known that he became a Shinigami shortly after Hinamori. He is also a friend of Jidanbou, the West Gate Keeper, and was the one who taught him the "city rules."  As a child, Hitsugaya was a bit of a brat who liked to eat watermelons and poke fun at Hinamori. The two were close friends and Hitsugaya, despite being younger and much shorter than his friend, always felt that he needed to protect her. With Hitsugaya's natural talent, he quickly entered the Shinigami Institute shortly after Hinamori, despite his age. She continued to call him "Shiro-chan" out of habit and felt she needed to protect him. Because of a promise she had made, she only began to call him "Hitsugaya-kun" after he had achieved his Zanpakutō's initial release and was recognized as a Shinigami. Highly capable and knowledgeable, he quickly became the youngest of the Captains within the Gotei 13. His favorite foods are watermelon and sweet nattou. He also hates hot weather.

characters.name: 松本乱菊
characters.description: 松本乱菊是《死神》中的角色，护廷十三队十番队副队长，日番谷冬狮郎的部下，持有斩魄刀灰猫，有橙色长发，性格开朗随性，喜欢喝酒，常在队务中照顾日番谷，与市丸银有旧识，战斗时能够让刀刃化为灰，重视身边的伙伴。她平时举止轻松，有时会逃避文书工作，真正遇到危险却能可靠地支援队长。与市丸银的过去，也让她对蓝染叛乱有复杂感受。
traits: 护廷十三队十番队副队长
常在队务中照顾日番谷
战斗时能够让刀刃化为灰

source.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")
__Zanpakutou:__ [Haineko](https://anilist.co/character/24771/Haineko)

Rangiku Matsumoto is the lieutenant of the 10th Division of the Gotei 13, serving under [Captain Toushirou Hitsugaya](https://anilist.co/character/245/Hitsugaya-Toushirou).

Rangiku tends to be a slacker who doesn't like paperwork and loves to drink sake. Her easy-going and free-spirited personality is in sharp contrast with the serious Hitsugaya, but the two seem to be quite close, regardless. Rangiku is almost constantly by his side and has shown her loyalty to him on several occasions. While she seems somewhat self-centered, she is sensitive to the feelings of others, evident when she sees the concern Hitsugaya has for [Momo Hinamori](https://anilist.co/character/1092/Hinamori-Momo), the guilt [Izuru Kira](https://anilist.co/character/1093/Kira-Izuru) shares with her when [Gin Ichimaru](https://anilist.co/character/1087/Ichimaru-Gin) is revealed as a traitor, and when [Orihime](https://anilist.co/character/7/Inoue-Orihime) feels depressed about her role in [Ichigo Kurosaki](https://anilist.co/character/5/Kurosaki-Ichigo)'s life. Despite her lackadaisical image, she can be extremely serious when needed. She's shown to be somewhat maternal, especially with Orihime and Momo.

characters.name: 碎蜂
characters.description: 碎蜂是《死神》中的角色，护廷十三队二番队队长，隐密机动总司令官，持有斩魄刀雀蜂，擅长高速近身战斗，使用瞬步，曾服侍四枫院夜一，对夜一抱有复杂感情，性格严肃要求严格，以暗杀战术见长，对队伍纪律十分重视。她把隐密机动的训练和职责看得极重，战斗风格迅速而凌厉。夜一离开尸魂界的经历曾使她受伤，也成为两人重逢时的重要冲突。
traits: 护廷十三队二番队队长

source.description:
__Race:__ Shinigami
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")
__Rank:__ Captain of the 2nd Division, Commander-in-Chief of the Onmitsukidō, Corps Commander of the Executive Militia Corp, 9th Head of the Fēng Family
__Previous Position:__ Bodyguard of [Yoruichi Shihouin](https://anilist.co/character/908/Yoruichi-Shihouin) Executive Militia member

Soi Fon is staunchly loyal, firm, and unbending in her beliefs. She is a hard worker and takes a strong moral stand — she particularly believes in following orders. She is generally reserved and not arrogant like her lieutenant. She will not hesitate in the slightest to strike down even her subordinates if they stand in her way. Soi Fon, like most female shinigami, is a member of the Shinigami Women's Association.

Underneath her standard shinigami captain uniform, Soi Fon wears the special forces leader's uniform, which has no sleeves or covering for the back. The reason the shoulders and the back are exposed is because of Soi Fon's ability to use shunkō (flash cry), an advanced technique that combines hand to hand combat and kidō and causes high spiritual pressure to accumulate at the shoulders and back, blasting away the fabric at the shoulders and back. Her hair is worn short with two long braids covered in cloth.

Long ago, she had a close friendship with Yoruichi Shihouin that went beyond the typical leader/subordinate relationship. When Youruichi left the soul society with no explanation, Soi Fon took it as a personal betrayal of her feelings, with gives rise to her intense hatred of anyone who disobeys orders or disturbs the harmony of the soul society. She finally comes to terms with her feelings toward Yoruichi during the "Rukia Rescue" arc, and the two becomes friends again soon after. Soi Fon has borderline romantic feelings toward Yoruichi which becomes evident on several occasions such as when she buys some photos of Yoroichi eating voraciously in skimpy clothing.

Soi Fon also has a personal dislike for [Kisuke Urahara](https://anilist.co/character/210/Urahara-Kisuke) because of his close relationship with Yuruichi. Another person she dislikes is her own lieutenant, [Oomaeda](https://anilist.co/character/5728/Oomaeda-Marechiyo), whom she punches quite frequently for his stupidity and cowardice.

The correct romanization of her name, as confirmed by [Kubo Tite](https://anilist.co/staff/96880/Kubo-Tite), is Suì-Fēng.

characters.name: 四枫院夜一
characters.description: 四枫院夜一是《死神》中的角色，四枫院家族成员，曾任二番队队长，曾统领隐密机动，擅长瞬步，能够变成黑猫，常协助浦原喜助，训练黑崎一护提升能力，性格洒脱善于戏弄他人，精通白打与瞬哄，与碎蜂有师徒般的旧缘。她离开尸魂界后仍暗中帮助浦原与一护，在关键时刻凭速度和战斗经验支援同伴。黑猫姿态与真实身份的反差，也是她初登场时的特色。
traits: 训练黑崎一护提升能力

source.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")
__Previous Position:__ ~!22nd Head of Shihōin Clan, Captain of the 2nd Division, Onmitsukidō Commander-in-Chief, Corrections Corps Commander, Executive Militia Corps Commander!~
__Partner:__ [Kisuke Urahara](https://anilist.co/character/210)

Yoruichi Shihouin is an attractive, dark-skinned woman who can transform into a black cat for long periods of time. She is intelligent and witty, and is intimately knowledgeable of Soul Society and its workings, as she was the former leader of the special forces. Although of noble birth, she acts differently from other nobles. For instance, she instructed [Soifon](https://anilist.co/character/905) to refer to her without using honorific suffixes. She also transforms into her human form directly in front of [Ichigo](https://anilist.co/character/5) on several occasions just to see his reaction to seeing her naked.  

Yoruichi tends to avoid battles, preferring to help after a fight is over, but she will step in if she thinks her side cannot win. She was responsible for training [Chad](https://anilist.co/character/575) and [Orihime](https://anilist.co/character/7) prior to their entrance into Soul Society. She also supervised Ichigo Kurosaki's final release training using the methods developed by Kisuke Urahara.

characters.name: 葛力姆乔·贾卡杰克
characters.description: 葛力姆乔·贾卡杰克是《死神》中的角色，蓝染麾下破面，十刃成员，编号曾为六，斩魄刀名豹王，战斗方式凶猛直接，与黑崎一护多次交锋，有蓝色头发，好胜心强，曾带领从属官行动，不愿屈服于对手。他渴望通过战斗证明自己的力量，把一护视为值得反复挑战的对手。即便身处蓝染的破面军势中，他仍坚持强烈的个人意志。

source.description:
__Height:__ 186 cm   
__Race:__ Arrancar    

Grimmjow appears to be a laid back and irreverent individual, but this scruffy appearance hides an impulsive, excessively violent personality and a lethally short temper. He is blunt, rude, and quite sadistic, revealing an insane grin in battle, much like [Kenpachi Zaraki](https://anilist.co/character/909/Zaraki-Kenpachi). Grimmjow has little respect for authority and says whatever is on his mind, regardless of whether or not it is appropriate.

Grimmjow is the sixth Espada in [Sousuke Aizen's](https://anilist.co/character/1086/Aizen-Sousuke) army of Arrancar, meaning he is ranked sixth in terms of strength. A crooked number 6 is tattooed on his back just above and to the right of his hollow hole. Aizen personally marks the Espada, the ten most powerful of his arrancar, with such tattoos as visible marks of their rank and ability.

characters.name: 乌尔奇奥拉·西法
characters.description: 乌尔奇奥拉·西法是《死神》中的角色，蓝染麾下破面，十刃成员，编号为四，脸上有绿色泪痕状纹路，斩魄刀名黑翼大魔，性格冷静寡言，负责看守井上织姬，与黑崎一护交战，常思考人心的含义，能够进行归刃战斗。他相信眼睛看不见的心难以证明，与织姬的相处却不断动摇这种看法。在虚圈与一护的战斗中，他展现出强大实力，也逐渐理解人类的情感。
traits: 脸上有绿色泪痕状纹路

source.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'7")

Ulquiorra is a male arrancar with a melancholic appearance. Ulquiora is the 4th ranked espada. Ulquiorra is also analytical; during his and Yammy's first visit to the human world, he makes several remarks on the humans who confront them. He theorizes that Orihime Inoue's healing power is a temporal-spatial ability, which Aizen describes as the rejection of fate, and comments on how Ichigo Kurosaki's final release can easily get through Yammy's defenses. He also notes Ichigo's power fluctuation, which varies between very weak and stronger than his own. It would appear that Ulquiorra and Grimmjow, the 6th Espada, are not on good terms. While Ulquiorra allowed Yammy to kill anyone he deemed as "trash", which included Ichigo, Ulquiorra allowed him to live based on his belief that Ichigo's power was so turbulent that eventually, he would destroy himself. Grimmjow's conflicting viewpoint was that Ichigo should have been destroyed outright, as he could overcome his weakness and grow even stronger. 

Despite Grimmjow's argument, Aizen trusted Ulquiorra's judgment. This disagreement led to Grimmjow's unauthorized assault on the real world. Though Ulquiorra is of a higher rank than Grimmjow, Grimmjow is confident that Ulquiorra is afraid to fight him for fear of them destroying one another. When released his zanpakutō, Murciélago (黒翼大魔 (ムルシエラゴ) ,Murushierago?, Japanese for "giant black-winged demon," Spanish for "bat") creates two large black wings on his back. His hollow helmet centers atop his head, sporting two large horns, and his arrancar uniform appears more form fitting at the top, becoming robe-like towards the bottom. Additionally, Ulquiorra is apparently unique among the Espada in that he has a second release; Resurrección Segunda Etapa (Spanish for "resurrection second stage"). He becomes more muscular with clawed hands and feet, the whites of his eyes turn black, and his helmet is replaced with elongated horns. He loses his clothes; his arms and legs from the hip down are covered in black fur, and he gains a long thin tail. In both forms he can create long "lances" of energy called Lanza del Relámpago (雷霆の 槍(ラソサ・デ ル ・レ ラソ パ ー ゴ ) ,ransa deru reranpāgo?, Japanese and Spanish for ”lance of the lightning”), and when thrown can cause an explosion. Ulquiorra seems unfamiliar with the technique when he uses it in his second release state, unexpectedly missing Ichigo with his first one, however, to compensate, he can produce more should his first miss the target. Theme song: "Moonshield," on the album "The Jester Race" by the group "In Flames."

characters.name: 蓝染惣右介
characters.description: 蓝染惣右介是《死神》中的角色，曾任护廷十三队五番队队长，持有斩魄刀镜花水月，能够施展完全催眠，长期隐藏真实意图，操纵虚圈的破面军势，曾在尸魂界策划叛乱，擅长利用他人信任，与黑崎一护长期对立，追求超越死神的力量，行事从容而善于布局。他起初以温和的队长形象示人，实际多年暗中策划夺取崩玉。身份暴露后，他成为尸魂界与现世共同面对的强敌，并不断推动冲突升级。
traits: 曾任护廷十三队五番队队长

source.description:
__Height:__ 186 cm (6'1")
__Rank:__  Captain of the 5th Division
__Zanpakutou:__ Kyouka Suigetsu  

Aizen is a polite, soft-spoken intellectual, often addressing his subordinates by their given names. He rarely shows any sign of alarm or distress and often has entire situations planned out well in advance. Whenever confronted, Aizen is casual and uncaring, attempting to draw out a conversation and make small talk, which often infuriates the one he is talking to. Aizen initially appeared to be a very kind, well-respected captain and was looked up to by many, especially his lieutenant, [Momo Hinamori](https://anilist.co/character/1092). However, there is far more than meets the eye when it comes to Aizen.

characters.name: 市丸银
characters.description: 市丸银是《死神》中的角色，曾任护廷十三队三番队队长，常眯起眼睛微笑，持有斩魄刀神枪，长期跟随蓝染行动，与松本乱菊自幼相识，说话带有玩笑与试探，真实意图长期难以判断，战斗时刀刃可迅速伸长，曾背离尸魂界，对乱菊怀有深厚感情。他看似忠于蓝染，行动却一直隐藏着自己的目的。与乱菊的旧日关系贯穿他的选择，也让其他人很难从表情和言语看透他的想法。
traits: 曾任护廷十三队三番队队长
真实意图长期难以判断
战斗时刀刃可迅速伸长

source.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Position:__ Captain of the 3rd Division, Lieutenant of the 5th Division

source.description:
__Dragonball:__ Yamcha, the notorious desert bandit, started out as an antagonist of [Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu) but quickly became his friend thanks to [Bulma](https://anilist.co/character/678/Bulma). He lived in the desert, which resulted in him never having much female contact. Whenever he encountered Bulma, he would blush immensely and become petrified right on the spot.  Yamcha's trade mark move was known as the Fist of the Wolf Fang. With this move, he would strike the opponent with his hands in a claw like pose with his middle finger, ring finger and thumb curled.  His best friend is a floating shift-shaping cat named [Pu'ar](https://anilist.co/character/677/Puar).

__Dragonball Z:__ Yamcha's cleaned up his act as a desert bandit and become a member of the Z-fighters as well as a student of [Master Roshi](https://anilist.co/character/6167/Muten-Roushi).  Yamcha gained incredible ki control as displayed in his new signature move the Spirit Ball.  With this move, he can guide a ki ball in any direction using his middle and index fingers. 

~!When the Saiyans, [Vegeta](https://anilist.co/character/913/Vegeta) and his henchman [Nappa](https://anilist.co/character/5224/Nappa), first came to earth. Yamcha was the first to die after Nappa planted the Saibaman.  In the Android Saga, Yamcha was the first to discover [Androids 19](https://anilist.co/character/6115/Jinzouningen-19gou) and [20](https://anilist.co/character/2146/Dr-Gero) and was the second to be harmed by them (after [Yajirobe](https://anilist.co/character/2097/Yajirobe)).!~

characters.name: 龟仙人
characters.description: 龟仙人是《龙珠》中的角色，别称武天老师，又被称作龟仙人，居住在龟仙屋，孙悟空与克林的师父，创立龟仙流修行方法，会使用龟派气功，常穿花衬衫和太阳镜，拥有丰富武术经验，曾化名成龙参加武道会，言行好色但认真指导弟子。他以严格又独特的训练方式培养悟空和克林，不只教战斗技巧，也强调身体与心性的成长。虽然平时举止滑稽，面对弟子的进步却十分认真。

source.description:
The "Turtle Immortal" is an ancient and wise martial arts master and the first Earthling to wield the Kamehameha. Though he seems frail, he is a mighty warrior. Muten-Rôshi trained [Grandpa Son Gohan](https://anilist.co/character/2104/Son-Gohan), [Ox King](https://anilist.co/character/2094/Gyuumaou), [Son Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu), [Kuririn](https://anilist.co/character/2159/Kuririn), and [Yamcha](https://anilist.co/character/4014/Yamcha). His home, Kame House, a shack on a small isolated island, serves as a gathering place for the Z Fighters and friends.

He is a stock character, as he is both the archetypal wise old man and dirty old man, the latter being typical of shōnen anime. Sometimes he gets cranky, which further provides comic relief. He is bald, with a thick goatee and a thick mustache. Muten-Rôshi wears beach clothes or a martial arts suit and a turtle shell on his back. He usually wields a walking stick.

His companions are usually [Oolong](https://anilist.co/character/2108/Oolong), [Umigame](https://anilist.co/character/2112/Umigame) and [Lunch](https://anilist.co/character/2105/Lunch).

Chi-Chi (チチ, Chichi) is the wife of Son Goku, and the mother of Son Gohan and Son Goten. She is often depicted as a sometimes nagging, overprotective but fundamentally well-meaning woman, who sincerely looks for her children and husband's well-being even when their views clash. She and Goku meet as children, and Goku promises to marry her thinking marriage is food. Several years later, she finds him at the 23rd Tenkaichi Budoukai, and despite confessing that he misunderstood what she had meant, he fulfills his promise and asks her to marry him. As she gets older, she disapproves of Goku's lifestyle, enough to ban Gohan from following in his foot steps, but due to the threats like Vegeta and Freeza, she is forced to let him train under Piccolo and Goku. She relaxes this with Goten by training him herself while Gohan is away for school. She has a wild temper and can react in violent anger over the slightest annoyance which means all of the Z Warriors fear her and try to avoid making her mad.  (Source: Dragon Ball Super Exciting Guide, Character Edition)

source.description: Tenshinhan is a fictional character from the Dragon Ball metaseries and the franchise equivalent created by Akira Toriyama. Trained by Muten-Rôshi's rival, the Crane hermit he starts out as an enemy of Son Goku, but soon makes peace and becomes an ally. He is usually accompanied by Chaozu, his training partner and best friend, whom he can communicate with telepathically.  At the time of his introduction, Tenshinhan is among the most powerful warriors in the series, matched only by Goku himself. Like most other characters, his relative strength quickly diminishes as the story progresses.  As is the case with a handful of other characters from the early chapters of Dragon Ball, Tenshinhan was inspired by a character from Journey to the West; his unique feature of having a third eye was derived from the Chinese god Erlang Shen.  According to the Daizenshuu book 7 and the PlayStation 2 game Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi, Tenshinhan belongs to the alien race of the "three-eyed".  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: 芙拉梅
characters.description: 芙拉梅是《葬送的芙莉莲》中的角色，传说中的人类魔法使，芙莉莲的师父，曾与赛丽艾学习魔法，生活在勇者辛美尔时代之前，教导芙莉莲隐藏魔力，对抗魔族，推动人类学习魔法，留下多种魔法研究，影响芙莉莲对魔法的理解，与徒弟建立深厚关系。她发现年幼的芙莉莲后将其收为弟子，教会她以长期压制魔力的方式欺骗魔族。她的理念在身后仍影响人类魔法发展与芙莉莲的旅程。

characters.description: 九十九由基是《咒术回战》中的角色，特级咒术师，长期在海外活动，关注咒灵产生的根本原因，主张研究让人类摆脱咒力的方法，曾与夏油杰交谈，是东堂葵的师父，战斗实力很强，性格洒脱直接，喜欢问人喜欢怎样的女性，与咒术高层理念不同。她不满足于只靠消灭咒灵处理问题，而是试图从人类咒力本身寻找解决办法。与夏油、东堂等人的相遇，也对他们的思考和成长产生影响。
